metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mdm/updates/{updateUuid}/groups/{organizationGroupUuid}?action=Start (SINGULAR path — resumes a rollout previously paused via action=Stop). Canonical docs say 202 Accepted with an empty body; confirmed on the wire — Content-Length came back as literal "0", no body bytes at all. Precondition discovered empirically on 26.4.0.0: this action requires a live deployment to already exist under the update+org group — calling it with zero deployments present returns 404 errorCode 5223 ("No deployment found for device update ... under organization group ..."), NOT 202. Captured here with one live deployment present under the update+org group (created solely as a precondition for this action, then deleted immediately after capture — cleanup verified via re-GET 404).
